all.paired_quality_scope: Only identical case IDs with valid applicable reviews on BOTH sides under the same judge protocol; failures excluded, selection bias possible. Not a full-set comparison.
all.note: Positive timing deltas mean slower. Fractions are not percent points. Single-pass uncontrolled comparisons are descriptive, not causal.
